description: This Java class 'FlexibleServletAccessor' provides flexible access to servlet request and session attributes, supporting nested map and list syntax for getting, setting, and removing attributes, with optional string expansion.

classes.name: FlexibleServletAccessor
classes.description: A generic class for flexible access to servlet request and session attributes, supporting nested map and list syntax.

classes.name: AttributeAccessor
classes.description: Inner class that handles detailed get, put, and remove operations on individual attributes, supporting list indexing and expansion.
